## 6. What to look for that no check can see

The gate checks arithmetic, the suite checks behaviour and CI checks both. None of them can see:

- A requirement from your plan that was implemented in a narrower form than you specified, where the narrower form passes its own tests.
- A detail you supplied in planning that was dropped because it was inconvenient, with nothing recording that it was dropped.
- Art that satisfies every manifest and still does not read as Redwall.
- A task in the queue whose title has drifted from what you actually asked for, so the work is correct against the title and wrong against you.
- Work the queue does not contain at all. Absence is the failure mode nothing in this repository can detect.
